query: How does resolution time vary by agent and issue type?

per_column.name: issue_type
per_column.rationale: Directly named in the query ('by issue type'); provides well-separated, interpretable categories (vpn, email, database, etc.) that can be grouped and compared against resolution_time.

per_column.name: assigned_agent
per_column.rationale: Directly named in the query ('by agent'); clean, low-cardinality set of named agents ideal for segmenting resolution_time. Overlaps with original assigned_to but is explicitly the requested dimension.

per_column.name: resolver_matches_assignee
per_column.rationale: Clean binary flag capturing whether the closer equals the assignee; an interpretable associational variable (reassignment/handoff) that plausibly relates to resolution_time and can be segmented on.

per_column.name: failure_mode
per_column.rationale: Interpretable, well-separated categories (connectivity_loss, no_access, crash_outage) offering an orthogonal lens on the nature of the failure vs resolution_time. Partially correlated with issue_type but adds a distinct semantic angle.

per_column.name: affected_system
per_column.rationale: Categories are interpretable but largely redundant with issue_type (vpn->vpn, email->email, database->database); it mostly restates the same partition rather than opening a new relationship.

per_column.name: issue_severity_signal
per_column.rationale: Well-separated severity-flavored categories (inaccessible, error, outage_down, degraded_slow) that give an interpretable severity-like axis to compare against resolution_time, complementing the existing priority column.

judge.rationale: The set strongly supports interpretable EDA on resolution_time. It squarely delivers the two requested dimensions (issue_type, assigned_agent) with clean, low-cardinality categories, plus genuinely informative extra segmentations: resolver_matches_assignee (handoff), failure_mode, and a severity-like signal. The main weakness is redundancy: affected_system, issue_type, and failure_mode overlap heavily in their partitioning, so several columns describe roughly the same underlying dimension rather than opening distinct relationships. No column is opaque or near-constant, and none merely restates resolution_time itself, so informativeness is high but not maximal.
